books.section: Topic 7.4 The Progressives — Progressivism and Woodrow Wilson
The Progressive Era and World War I (1900-1920)

stimulus.source_note: Paraphrase of 5 Steps to a 5 2024, Chapter 20, and Barron's Premium 2027, Chapter 9.
stimulus.text: Paraphrase of 5 Steps to a 5 2024, Chapter 20, and Barron's Premium 2027, Chapter 9: Woodrow Wilson won in 1912 on his New Freedom program. In 1913 he cut tariffs with the Underwood Tariff Act and signed the Federal Reserve Act, creating a central banking system of twelve regional banks to steady credit and the currency. The Sixteenth Amendment, ratified in 1913, let Congress collect an income tax. In 1914 the Clayton Antitrust Act outlawed price discrimination and exempted labor unions from antitrust prosecution, and the Federal Trade Commission Act created a commission to police unfair business practices.

source: original; stimulus paraphrased from 5 Steps to a 5 2024, Chapter 20, and Barron's Premium 2027, Chapter 9
stem: The Federal Reserve Act of 1913 created

options.text: a central banking system of twelve regional banks
a single national bank located in Washington
options.misconception: The system was decentralized: twelve regional banks overseen by a board in Washington, not one national bank.
The income tax came from the Sixteenth Amendment, ratified the same year, not from the Federal Reserve Act.
The commission came from the Federal Trade Commission Act of 1914, a separate law.

rationales.A: The passage says the act created a central banking system of twelve regional banks to steady credit and the currency, overseen by a board in Washington.
rationales.B: There was no single national bank. The system used twelve regional banks under a Washington board.
rationales.C: The income tax came from the Sixteenth Amendment. The Federal Reserve Act built the banking system.
rationales.D: The Federal Trade Commission came a year later, from its own act in 1914.
rationales.general:
1. Read the passage's sentence. The Federal Reserve Act created a central banking system of twelve regional banks.
2. Name its job. To steady credit and the currency after panics like the one in 1907.
3. Rule out the look-alikes. The income tax and the trade commission came from other laws of the same years.
Remember: reforms of the same year are easy to mix up, so attach each law to its own sentence.
